selected.title: SEC publishes new crypto custody rules
selected.summary: The US Securities and Exchange Commission has proposed new rules designed to establish a dedicated legal framework for crypto custody within the wealth management and advisory market
selected.why: SEC proposed new rules for crypto custody.

reason: SEC crypto custody rules create testable claim about whether dedicated framework actually improves consumer protection or just regulatory arbitrage
angle: New SEC crypto custody rules will reduce fraud and losses only if they establish meaningful standards; unclear rules simply legitimize existing practices without protection.
